channel.title: Cote d'Ivoire - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Cote d'Ivoire, every source cited.

item.title: Ivory Coast potato imports climb 45% to $12.5 million
item.description: Egypt's potato exports to Ivory Coast rose to $1.68 million in 2025, up from $14,000 in 2020.

item.title: Ivory Coast removed from FATF grey list
item.description: The Financial Action Task Force removed Ivory Coast from its list of countries under enhanced surveillance.

item.title: Ivory Coast anti-corruption court investigated for corruption
item.description: The FBI alerted Ivorian gendarmes to a corruption network within the economic and financial crimes court in Abidjan.

item.title: Ivory Coast links climate policy and health for COP31
item.description: The health ministry organised a national dialogue on climate and health in Abidjan on October 30, 2026.

item.title: 37 French firms seek deals in West Africa
item.description: A delegation led by Business France is visiting Nigeria, Senegal, and Ivory Coast to secure partnerships and clients.
